generated_text.overview: Project hanqaqa/easyduino Raspberry Pi Pico 2040 current is a KiCad project containing 115 extracted component records. The catalogue matcher linked 33 physical placements to OOMP parts.
design_notes: The extracted board outline is approximately 21.0 mm by 51.0 mm.
Placement data contains 53 front-side and 5 back-side components.
review_notes: 32 physical component records are not yet matched to an OOMP part.
The extractor reports 14 named-net comparisons that differ between schematic and PCB data.
